$comment: FR-11 agent contract. Tools the SRE agent uses to consume the serving layer. Schemas mirror service/design.md contracts for /route and /get.

tools.name: wiki_route
tools.description: Route an operational question to the most relevant curated wiki sections. Call this BEFORE answering any operational question. Returns ranked hits with provenance and version applicability; does not return body text.

query.description: The operational question or symptom/error string.

version.description: Product version to gate on, e.g. '26.6'. Hits whose applies_to lacks it are dropped before ranking.

tools.name: wiki_get
tools.description: Fetch the curated content for a routed hit. Returns the scoped H2 section (inject=section) or the whole file (inject=full), plus frontmatter and provenance. 404 with a reason for source-only / non-routable / missing paths.

path.description: Repo-relative path from a wiki_route hit. Must stay within the repo (../, absolute, source-only are rejected).

section.description: Anchor from the hit (omit for inject=full files).
